verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents automation via the Shortcuts app (docs-28) and a WebDAV server for file transfer (docs-27), which allow some programmatic/agentic control, but there is no documented REST/OpenAPI or general-purpose public API — probes confirm no openapi.json, no llms.txt, and no machine-readable docs endpoint. missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI-style API, API reference/docs, and independent confirmation that AI agents can drive it beyond Shortcuts.
